name: vwap_rsi_volume_confluence_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: When NIFTY drops sharply below its session VWAP (z-score < -1.5 by rolling 20-minute stddev) while the 2-minute RSI falls below 25 AND index volume spikes 2x+ the 20-minute average, it signals a climax selloff from stop cascades or algorithmic de-risking that has overshot fair value. VWAP-benchmarked institutions — responsible for a large share of NIFTY intraday flow — become aggressive buyers when receiving fills well below their session benchmark, providing mechanical buy-side pressure within 30-90 seconds. The volume surge is critical: it distinguishes institutional participation (stop-cascade climax) from thin-market drift below VWAP, making the reversion higher-probability than z-score or RSI alone. All three conditions firing simultaneously reduces false positives by filtering out slow drifts (high z-score, low volume) and noise spikes (high volume, z-score not extreme).

indicators.name: session_vwap
indicators.formula: cumsum(close * volume) / cumsum(volume), reset at 09:15 daily
indicators.purpose: Cumulative session VWAP — no scaling needed regardless of bar size. Resets daily at market open. Used identically to the original; institutional benchmark that VWAP-tracking algorithms use regardless of bar frequency.

indicators.name: vwap_dev_std_240
indicators.purpose: 20-minute rolling standard deviation of VWAP deviation (240 x 5s bars). Original used 60 1-min bars = 60-minute window. Compressed to 20 minutes because NIFTY intraday volatility regimes shift frequently (macro prints, options expiry moves) and a 60-min stddev would lag these regime changes by 40-50 minutes. 20 minutes is the minimum window to get a statistically robust stddev while remaining responsive to intraday regime shifts.

indicators.name: vwap_zscore
indicators.purpose: Primary entry trigger — normalized VWAP deviation. Z-score normalization is superior to fixed percentage threshold (used in vwap_rsi_confluence_v1) because it adapts to each day's actual volatility: a 20-pt move below VWAP is extreme on a quiet day but unremarkable on an expiry day. Threshold -1.5/+1.5 retained from original.

indicators.name: rsi_24
indicators.purpose: 2-minute RSI at 5-second bars (24 x 5s = 120s). Original used RSI(7) on 1-min bars = 7-minute momentum window. Compressed to 2 minutes (24 bars) because we trade the fast overshoot exhaustion — the first bounce leg within 15-90 seconds — not the slow recovery to RSI 50. RSI(84) = 7-min equivalent would be too slow to generate actionable signals at our hold times. RSI threshold tightened to 25/75 (vs original 20/80) because NIFTY index is smoother than individual stocks; RSI rarely hits 20 on the index.

indicators.name: vol_ratio_240
indicators.purpose: Volume surge filter: current bar volume vs 20-minute rolling average. SAME time window as original (SMA(20) on 1-min = 20 minutes), just more bars (240 x 5s vs 20 x 1min). This is the KEY differentiator vs vwap_rsi_confluence_v1 which has no volume filter. Volume surge on NIFTY confirms institutional program selling (stop cascades) vs random drift — the distinction that makes the reversion more reliable. Threshold reduced to 2.0x from original's 3.0x because NIFTY index volume is less spiky than individual stocks.

conditions: VIX < 22 (exclude panic regimes where VWAP deviations persist)
buy_ce.confirmation: all three signal conditions must fire simultaneously on the same 5-second bar

buy_pe.confirmation: all three signal conditions must fire simultaneously on the same 5-second bar

exit.stop_rationale: 4 option pts = ~8 NIFTY spot points at delta 0.5. A climax-selloff entry at -1.5 stddev VWAP with volume confirmation should not see a further 8-spot-pt move against entry if the stop cascade is exhausting. If NIFTY drops another 8 pts from entry, the institutional selling wave is still ongoing, not exhausted — exit to avoid riding a genuine breakdown. 30-second NIFTY moves in confirmed institutional selling are 10-20 pts; the 8-pt threshold separates normal overshoot continuation from thesis failure.
exit.target_rationale: 7 option pts = ~14 NIFTY spot points at delta 0.5. NIFTY mean-reversion from -1.5 stddev VWAP (a typical deviation of 30-60 spot points) typically covers 20-40 spot pts in the first 60-90 seconds as VWAP-benchmarked buyers absorb supply. Targeting 14 pts captures ~35-70% of expected reversion at 1:1.75 R:R — realistic for a 90-second maximum hold without requiring a full VWAP reclaim.

filters.vix_filter: VIX < 22 — above 22, macro panic selling creates VWAP deviations that persist for 5-15 minutes rather than reverting in 30-90 seconds; VWAP-benchmarked buyers step aside during panic
filters.time_filter: 09:25-15:20 IST — skip first 10 min (VWAP and rolling std need warmup; opening auction volume spikes inflate vol_ratio giving false signals) and last 10 min (EOD squaring distorts VWAP)
filters.volume_filter: vol_ratio_240 > 2.0 — core signal condition, not an additional filter; confirms institutional participation vs thin-tape drift
filters.trend_filter: none — pure mean reversion to VWAP; VIX filter handles trend days with macro catalysts
filters.spread_filter: not applicable — limit order execution at candle close prices, no bid-ask spread cost

edge.edge_decay_risk: low — triple-confluence of z-score, RSI, and volume is rare enough to avoid crowding; VWAP-benchmarking is a structural institutional mandate, not alpha-seeking behavior that can arbitrage away

adaptation_notes: 1. Universe: dropped from 30 individual Nifty50 stocks to NIFTY index directly — the triple-confluence logic applies to the index and is arguably stronger because NIFTY VWAP is tracked by more participants (FII desks, ETF rebalancers, index futures arbitrageurs) than any single stock's VWAP. 2. RSI period: compressed from RSI(7) on 1-min = 7 min to RSI(24) on 5s = 2 min, matching our 15-90 second hold time rather than the original 5-30 minute hold. 3. VWAP deviation: original used percentage threshold (implied); converted to z-score normalization (rolling 20-min stddev) so the threshold adapts to each session's actual volatility level. Window shortened from 60 min to 20 min. 4. Volume normalization: window kept at same 20-minute time span, just more bars (240 vs 20). Threshold reduced from 3.0x to 2.0x because NIFTY index volume is less spiky than individual stocks. 5. Key differentiation from vwap_rsi_confluence_v1 (Strategy_146 conversion): that strategy uses % deviation + RSI slope + candle confirmation; this strategy uses z-score normalization + volume surge as the third factor — structurally different triple-confluence from a different original thesis.
weaknesses: Extremely rare signal — all three conditions simultaneously on NIFTY index may fire only 1-3 times per day; low trade frequency limits statistical significance

During genuine NIFTY breakdown (FII selling spree, geopolitical shock), all three conditions fire but NIFTY continues lower — stop loss execution is essential; the triple-confluence becomes a false positive in momentum crashes
VWAP z-score is unreliable in the first 20-30 minutes of session before rolling stddev has enough data; session_start filter at 09:25 partially mitigates this
NIFTY index volume data is synthetic (computed from constituent futures volumes); spikes can reflect data aggregation artifacts rather than genuine institutional activity
